# .NET API reference

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Every public type in the .NET library, grouped by what it is for. Each page lists its constructors, properties and methods with signatures, and an example where one exists. The TypeScript library has the same pages: see the [TypeScript API reference](../typescript/README.md).

## Document

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`Document`](document.md) | High-level entry point for creating PDF documents. |
| [`BonniePdfException`](bonnie-pdf-error.md) | Base type for exceptions raised by BonniePDF itself (content that cannot be encoded, tree operations that would produce invalid output, etc.), as opposed to exceptions from the BCL or the caller's own code. |
| [`Border`](border.md) | Represents border widths for the four sides of an element. |
| [`BorderColors`](border-colors.md) | Represents border colors for the four sides of an element |
| [`BorderStyle`](border-style.md) | Provides semantic border width presets for common use cases. |
| [`Color`](color.md) | Represents an RGB color with values ranging from 0 to 255. |
| [`ColorPalette`](color-palette.md) | A Tailwind v4 colour ramp: eleven fixed shade stops (50 → 950) addressed by index, e.g. `ColorPalette.Red[500]`. |
| [`DiagnosticCategory`](diagnostic-category.md) | Category of a `Diagnostic` - what subsystem produced it. |
| [`DiagnosticsCollector`](diagnostics-collector.md) | Collects diagnostics during PDF generation. |
| [`DiagnosticSeverity`](diagnostic-severity.md) | Severity of a `Diagnostic`. |
| [`HorizontalAlignment`](horizontal-alignment.md) | Horizontal alignment options for layout elements |
| [`Hyperlink`](hyperlink.md) | Represents a hyperlink annotation in a PDF document. |
| [`Diagnostic`](i-diagnostic.md) | Structured, non-throwing report of a recoverable issue encountered while generating a PDF - most commonly a font that couldn't be loaded, an image that failed to decode, or a subset operation that fell back to embedding  |
| [`LengthExtensions`](length-extensions.md) | Unit-qualified measurements for object-initializer authoring. |
| [`MissingGlyphException`](missing-glyph-exception.md) | Raised when text uses a character that no registered font can draw and the document's `MissingGlyphs` is `Throw`. |
| [`PageOrientation`](page-orientation.md) | Represents the orientation of a PDF page |
| [`Point`](point.md) | Represents a 2D point with X and Y coordinates |
| [`SectionLink`](section-link.md) | A clickable internal cross-reference. |
| [`Size`](size.md) | Represents a 2D size with width and height |
| [`Thickness`](thickness.md) | Represents padding or margin values for the four sides of an element |
| [`Unit`](unit.md) | Measurement units for lengths and dimensions. |
| [`Units`](units.md) | Provides unit conversion utilities for measurements |
| [`VerticalAlignment`](vertical-alignment.md) | Vertical alignment options for layout elements. |

## Elements

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`ElementBase`](element-base.md) | Base class for PDF elements that provides common functionality for margin handling, Y-position tracking, and content width calculation. |
| [`IElement`](i-element.md) | Interface for all renderable PDF elements |
| [`IMargin`](i-margin.md) | Interface for elements that support margins |
| [`IStatefulElement`](i-stateful-element.md) | Interface for elements that support stateful rendering across page boundaries. |
| [`RenderStatus`](render-status.md) | Indicates the result of rendering an element to a page. |

## Tables

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`Table`](table.md) | A table element with support for column weights, cell padding, borders, headers, and footers |
| [`Grid`](grid.md) | A layout grid: arranges content in weighted columns and aligned rows for visual layout — address blocks, totals boxes, forms, side-by-side panels — as opposed to tabular data. |
| [`TableCell`](table-cell.md) | A table cell with support for custom styling, background color, and padding overrides |
| [`TableRow`](table-row.md) | A table row with support for custom styling and background color |

| [`GroupedBarChart`](grouped-bar-chart.md) | Grouped bar chart that renders multiple bars per category. |

| [`LineChart`](line-chart.md) | Line chart that renders connected data points with straight lines. |

| [`PieChart`](pie-chart.md) | Pie chart that renders pie slices with a legend on the right side. |

| [`TableRowDescriptor`](table-row-descriptor.md) | Describes a table row (used for headers and footers). |
| [`TextAlignment`](text-alignment.md) | Horizontal alignment of text within the width available to it. |
| [`TextBlockExtensions`](text-block-extensions.md) | Fluent extension methods for text blocks |
| [`TextDecoration`](text-decoration.md) | Text decoration styles that can be combined using bitwise OR. |
| [`TextDescriptor`](text-descriptor.md) | Describes rich text content with multiple spans. |
| [`TextElementBase`](text-element-base.md) | Base class for text-based PDF elements that provides common functionality for font handling, text encoding, and line wrapping. |
| [`TextSpan`](text-span.md) | A styled segment of text within a RichText element. |
| [`TextSpanDescriptor`](text-span-descriptor.md) | Provides fluent styling methods for a text span within a `TextDescriptor`. |
| [`TextStyle`](text-style.md) | Defines the visual style for text rendering. |
| [`Translate`](translate-class.md) | Moves native painted content without changing its original flow box. |
| [`Unconstrained`](unconstrained.md) | Renders its child outside the flow: the child draws from the current cursor position but consumes no height, so whatever follows starts where the child started. |
| [`UnorderedList`](unordered-list.md) | An unordered list element that displays bulleted items with various bullet styles |
| [`UnsupportedFeature`](unsupported-feature.md) | A feature encountered that the supported profile does not cover. |
| [`VerticalStackExtensions`](vertical-stack-extensions.md) | Fluent extension methods for vertical stacks |
| [`VisualToc`](visual-toc.md) | Renders a visual Table of Contents with dotted leaders and right-aligned page numbers, built from a list of heading identifiers that were registered during layout. |
| [`WidthDistribution`](width-distribution.md) | Width distribution mode for HorizontalStack children |
